content.outro: The iron door stands open, and the old garden is yours to walk.
content.premise: Old Wenna's cottage stands at the end of the lane with its garden locked behind it. She has left the latch for whoever comes: through her yard gate, through the kitchen and the door to the back room, and the iron door to the garden opens when the latch is lifted.
content.theme: A hedged yard with a wooden gate, a cottage of two rooms joined by an oak door, oak trapdoors over the stair to its cellar, and an iron door at the back that opens only when the latch is lifted.
content.title: The Latch
